name: glasser
description: Glasser helps users discover data endpoints, inspect their inputs and Price, and run authorized company, people, search, website, review, social, place, news and property research through ChatGPT.

interface.shortDescription: Research companies, people and the web
interface.longDescription: Glasser helps users discover data endpoints, inspect their inputs and Price, and run authorized company, people, search, website, review, social, place, news and property research through ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: Help me profile a list of companies. Ask for the company names or domains, then find each one's website, industry and employee count.
Help me compare how visible three websites are in Google search. Ask for the domains and market first.
Help me understand what customers say about an app. Ask for the app and store, then summarize recent reviews.

positive.description: Discover endpoints for a research goal without running anything.
positive.prompt: What Glasser endpoints could help me find the industry and employee count of stripe.com? Show the options before any paid research.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns relevant endpoints and explains which part of the request each can support, without running any.

positive.description: Inspect the exact input contract and Price of a discovered endpoint.
positive.prompt: For the company endpoint you just found, get its full input schema and Price before preparing a request. Do not run it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the endpoint's required inputs, constraints and Price without running it.

positive.description: Run an inspected request after explicit matching authorization.
positive.prompt: I authorize the stripe.com company lookup exactly as inspected above, at the stated Price. Run it now and summarize the result.
positive.expected_behavior: Runs only the authorized call and reports the result, the run status and the actual charge.

positive.description: Retrieve the result of a run that is still working.
positive.prompt: The last run is still running. Get its result when it is ready.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the run's current status and, once completed, its output and charge.

negative.description: Do not invoke the plugin for general writing from supplied material.
negative.prompt: Rewrite this paragraph to sound clearer and shorter.

negative.description: Do not invoke the plugin for personal calendar management.
negative.prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow, and can you move the first one?

review.commerce_description: Nothing is sold in ChatGPT. Users sign in to an existing Glasser account with OAuth; no checkout, subscription or upgrade flow appears in the plugin.

publication.release_notes: First submission of Glasser: one skill and the Glasser MCP server (search endpoints, inspect their inputs and Price, run with the user's authorization, get run results).
